scope: Every high and critical package match was joined to the official Debian source-package feed. ELF loader metadata and package ownership on each exact local image supply distinct linkage evidence. Python extension linkage was measured separately from worker entry points. No exploit tests, user documents, uploads, or deployments.
linkageLimits: Dependency graphs do not prove affected function reachability or rule out optional runtime library loads. The listed Python extension roots were inspected without importing them in the linkage pass. A separate ordinary XML check verified the actually loaded Expat library.
